claim: Canneto sull'Oglio to Mantova is roughly 39 km / about 33 minutes by car, just outside a 30-km radius.
quote: La distanza da Canneto Sull'oglio (MN) a Mantova (MN) è di 39 km... il tempo di percorrenza è di 33 minuti

claim: From 13 Jan 2026 the Palazzo Ducale full ticket including Castello di San Giorgio with Camera degli Sposi rises to €18 (reduced €11 without Camera), and Camera capacity grows to 30 visitors every 10 minutes.
quote: biglietto intero a 18 euro... biglietto ridotto a 11 euro... capienza della Camera degli Sposi passerà da 26 a 30 persone ogni 10 minuti

claim: Palazzo Ducale Mantova opens Tuesday–Sunday 08:15–19:15 (last entrance 18:20) and is closed Mondays, 25 Dec, 1 Jan.
quote: from Tuesday to Sunday, from 8.15 a.m. to 7.15 p.m, last entrance at 6.20 p.m. The Museum is closed on Mondays, December 25th and January 1st

claim: Palazzo Te opens Monday 9–19, Tuesday 13–19, Wed–Sun 9–19; full ticket €15, reduced €11, and includes the MACA Museum and Tempio Leon Battista Alberti.
quote: Monday: 9 am – 7.00 pm | Tuesday: 1 pm – 7.00 pm | Wednesday to Sunday: 9 am – 7.00 pm... Full price: €15... Palazzo Te ticket also allows admission to the MACA Museum and the Tempio Leon Battista Alberti

claim: Mantua and Sabbioneta were jointly inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2008 as two complementary expressions of Renaissance town planning.
quote: Mantua and Sabbioneta, in the Po valley... represent two aspects of Renaissance town planning: Mantua shows the renewal and extension of an existing city, while Sabbioneta represents the implementation of the period's theories about planning the ideal city

claim: Basilica di Sant'Andrea, an Alberti-designed Renaissance church on Piazza Mantegna, is open daily 08:00–12:00 and 15:00–19:00 with free entry.
quote: La Basilica è aperta tutti i giorni dalle 8.00 alle 12.00 e dalle 15.00 alle 19.00. L'ingresso è libero

claim: Kalatà runs paid guided tours of the Sant'Andrea basilica, crypt and (from 4 May 2026) the dome, by reservation.
quote: visite guidate alla Basilica e alla Cripta... visite guidate alla Cupola della Basilica dal 4 maggio 2026

claim: The 11th-century Rotonda di San Lorenzo on Piazza delle Erbe is Mantua's oldest church; entry is by free donation, weekdays 10:00–13:00 / 14:30–18:30 (summer), weekends 10:00–19:00.
quote: Da lunedì a venerdì: Estate 10.00-13.00 e 14.30-18.30... Sabato, domenica e festivi: 10.00-19.00... ingresso gratuito a offerta libera

claim: Navigazione Mincio runs roughly 1.5-hour boat tours through the Mincio reserve from March to October, with the Lago Superiore lotus bloom running late June to early September.
quote: Il periodo è da fine giugno ai primi di settembre... da marzo ad ottobre

claim: Boats and small craft operated by Mincio barcaioli explore Lago Superiore, di Mezzo and Inferiore from Mantua, Grazie di Curtatone and Rivalta sul Mincio.
quote: partenze regolari da Mantova, Grazie di Curtatone e Rivalta sul Mincio... motonavi, motobarche elettriche, barche solari e canoe

claim: Campo Canoa park-and-ride has ~250 free spaces with a free shuttle to Piazza Sordello in front of Palazzo Ducale every 12 minutes (Mon–Fri 7:00–21:00, weekends 9:00–21:00).
quote: free shuttle bus connects the Campo Canoa parking lot with the city center... every 12 minutes... Monday to Friday from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM; Saturday and Sunday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM

claim: Mantua's main weekly market is on Thursday mornings in Piazza Sordello and the historic-centre streets, occasionally relocated to Piazza Virgiliana for events.
quote: mercato del giovedì... si sposta in Piazza Virgiliana... banchi del mercato da piazza Sordello a piazza Virgiliana

claim: Casa del Mantegna, the painter's own house south of the centre near Palazzo Te, is open Tue–Sun 10:00–12:30 and 15:00–18:00 (closed Tuesday and Wednesday afternoons).
quote: Tuesday to Sunday 10:00 – 12:30 and 15:00 – 18:00 (closed Tuesday and Wednesday afternoons)

claim: Sabbioneta single combined ticket: full €20.00, reduced €17.00, groups of 20+ €15.00, family €45.00; admits the 6 monuments (Teatro all'Antica, Palazzo Ducale, Palazzo Giardino + Galleria degli Antichi, Synagogue, Museo del Ducato, Incoronata) and is valid one year for unvisited sites; Tue-Fri 10-13/14:30-18, Sat-Sun 10-13/14:30-19.
quote: Full price € 20.00 · Reduced € 17.00 · Groups (20+) € 15.00 · Family € 45.00. allows the visit of the 6 monuments open to the public in Sabbioneta and is valid for 1 year for any unvisited sites. Tuesday-Friday 10:00-13:00, 14:30-18:00; Sat-Sun & Holidays 10:00-13:00, 14:30-19:00. Piazza d'Armi, 1

claim: Vespasiano I Gonzaga began building Sabbioneta in 1556 as an ideal Renaissance city between Mantua and Parma; it was declared an autonomous Duchy in 1577 and the project was completed in 1591.
quote: In 1556, he started his major project, the construction of a new, ideal city between Mantua and Parma which he christened 'Sabbioneta' ('Sandy'), as it was to rise on the sandy banks of the Po River. The project was finished in 1591.

claim: The Galleria degli Antichi is a 96-metre stone-and-brick corridor built 1584-1586 to house Vespasiano Gonzaga's collection of antique marbles acquired in Rome and Venice, the third-longest such gallery in Europe after the Uffizi and the Vatican.
quote: 96 meters long it is the third largest in Europe after the Uffizi Gallery in Florence and the Gallery of Geographic Maps of the Vatican. The gallery was built with stone and brick in 1584–1586.

claim: The Sabbioneta Synagogue was built in 1824 to Carlo Visioli's design above an earlier prayer room, with a vaulted ceiling like a sail by Swiss stuccoist Pietro Bolla; it reopened to the public in 1994 after the local Jewish community (1436-1937) died out.
quote: The synagogue was built in 1824 based on architect Carlo Visioli's design... The most striking element is its vaulted ceiling resembling 'a sail swollen by wind,' decorated with stuccoes created in 1840 by Swiss artist Pietro Bolla... the synagogue was reopened to the public in 1994.

claim: Sabbioneta's Renaissance monuments include the Teatro all'Antica by Vincenzo Scamozzi, the Palazzo Ducale (now town hall), the Palazzo del Giardino with its Galleria degli Antichi, the historic synagogue and churches with Campi-family frescoes, all within hexagonal star-shaped fortifications.
quote: Teatro all'antica (Theatre in the Ancients' style) by Vincenzo Scamozzi; Palazzo Ducale (now Town Hall); Galleria degli Antichi and Palazzo del Giardino; Historic synagogue with notable Hebrew printing heritage; Multiple churches featuring frescoes by the Campi family

claim: The Teatro all'Antica in Sabbioneta, designed by Vincenzo Scamozzi and built 1588-1590, is regarded as the first purpose-built free-standing theatre in Europe.
quote: The Teatro all'Antica, built between 1588 and 1590 to a design by architect Vincenzo Scamozzi, is the first stable theatre in Europe.

claim: Sabbioneta marked the 200th anniversary of its synagogue in November 2024, underscoring its inclusion in the UNESCO 'ideal city' inscription alongside its renowned 16th-century Hebrew printing heritage.
quote: Day-long events mark the 200th anniversary of the synagogue in Sabbioneta, an 'ideal city' that is on UNESCO's world heritage roster

claim: The road distance from Canneto sull'Oglio to Sabbioneta is roughly 19-22 km, a 25-30 minute drive across the flat lower Mantuan plain via Casalmaggiore/Commessaggio routes.
quote: distance (km, mile), route on the map between Canneto Sull'oglio and nearby comuni; Sabbioneta lies in the same province of Mantua approximately 19 km to the south-southeast.

claim: Straight-line distance Canneto sull'Oglio to Cremona is 31 km; road distance 33.1 km, drive ~31 minutes
quote: The distance between Canneto sull'Oglio and Cremona is 31 km. The road distance is 33.1 km.

claim: Museo del Violino full ticket €14, reduced €11; violin recital tickets €12 adults and €6 children up to 10
quote: Full price: €14.00 Reduced price: €11.00 ... Violin Recitals: Adults: €12.00 Children (up to 10 years): €6.00

claim: Museum holds Stradivari artifacts, a reconstructed violin-making workshop, the Treasure Box collection and the Friends of Stradivari collection
quote: the museum contains the Stradivari finds, the reconstruction of a violin making workshop and two collections of inestimable value: the Treasure trove and the Friends of Stradivari

claim: Torrazzo stands 112.54 m and is the oldest brick structure over 100 m still standing, completed in 1309
quote: 112.54 metres (369+1/4 ft) ... the oldest brick structure taller than 100 m that is still standing

claim: Climbing the Torrazzo requires 502 steps; combined ticket with Baptistery roughly €10, Vertical Museum admission about €7
quote: The 502-step climb ... Combined tickets cost €10.00; Torrazzo-only tickets are €5.00 on Mondays; Vertical Museum admission is approximately €7

claim: Cremona Cathedral was founded in 1107; Baptistery is an octagonal terracotta building from 1167 with a self-supporting dome
quote: Founded in 1107 ... An octagonal terracotta structure from 1167 with a structurally self-supporting dome

claim: The cathedral nave carries a major Renaissance fresco cycle of the Stories of the Virgin and Jesus by Boccaccino (begun 1514) and Pordenone (finished 1520)
quote: begun in 1514 by Boccaccio Boccaccino and completed in 1520 by Pordenone

claim: Traditional violin craftsmanship in Cremona was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2012
quote: Cremonese violin craftsmanship is highly renowned for its traditional process of fashioning and restoring violins, violas, cellos and contrabasses

claim: Workshop visits in Cremona are arranged through the tourist Infopoint (+39 0372 407081) by phone or email; no online booking
quote: Call the Infopoint (+39 0372 407081) or send an email to info.turismo@comune.cremona.it: we will be happy to help you and organize your visit in a workshop!

claim: Cremona torrone legend ties its birth to the 1441 wedding banquet of Bianca Maria Visconti and Francesco Sforza, shaped like the city's Torrione bell tower
quote: torrone was officially born for the wedding banquet of Bianca Maria Visconti and Francesco Sforza on 25 October 1441, and was a compact preparation with almonds, honey and egg whites, modelled in the shape of Cremona's belltower

claim: Sperlari, founded by Enea Sperlari around the mid-19th century via the Augusto Fieschi workshop (1867), is the historic Cremona torrone house with its flagship shop on Via Solferino
quote: Augusto Fieschi, a passionate connoisseur of the centuries-old Cremonese gastronomic traditions, began in 1867 to produce torrone, mustard and typical sweets

claim: Vergani torrone was founded by Secondo Vergani in 1881 in an 18th-century building, still operating in Cremona today
quote: In 1881, the premises on the ground floor of an 18th-century building were purchased by Secondo Vergani to start his activity

claim: Mostarda di Cremona is candied mixed fruit (pears, apples, mandarins, figs, apricots, peaches, cherries) preserved in a sugar syrup flavoured with mustard essence, paired with boiled meats and cheeses
quote: made with mixed fruit (pears, apples, mandarins, figs, apricots, peaches, and cherries), sugar, and mustard essence

claim: The Museo del Giocattolo in Canneto sull'Oglio is at Piazza Gramsci, with seasonal hours and rooms covering Furga ceramics, felt/papier-mache/PVC dolls and construction toys.
quote: Piazza Gramsci 46013 - Canneto sull'Oglio (MN) ... Sala Grigia: Canneto 1880, Furga ceramics, dolls in felt and papier-mache ... November-March Saturday 14:30-18:30 Sunday 10:00-12:30 e 14:30-18:30

claim: Canneto's Museo Civico hosts the Collezione del Giocattolo Giulio Superti Furga, founded 1984, with hundreds of dolls and toys from local production.
quote: La Collezione del Giocattolo Giulio Superti Furga fu fondata nel 1984 ... centinaia di bambole e giocattoli di varie epoche e materiali, prevalentemente di produzione cannetese

claim: Furga, the first Italian doll factory, was founded in Canneto sull'Oglio between 1870-1875 by nobleman Luigi Furga Gornini and operated until 1993; from 1922 it produced porcelain heads stamped 'Furga-Canneto sull'Oglio-Italy'.
quote: Luigi Furga & C. e stata una azienda manifatturiera di giocattoli, e in particolare di bambole, con sede a Canneto sull'Oglio (Mantova), che inizio la sua attivita fra il 1870 e il 1875 e chiuse nel 1993

claim: Asola's Cathedral of Sant'Andrea, begun 1472 and consecrated 1501, houses an Antegnati organ with decorative work by Romanino, a polyptych of Our Lady of Mercy by Antonio della Corna, and altarpieces by Palma il Giovane.
quote: constructed beginning in 1472 and consecrated in January 1501 ... the Antegnati organ, featuring decorative elements by artist Girolamo Romanino ... A Polyptych of Our Lady of Mercy (15th century) by Antonio della Corna

claim: The Romanino organ shutters in Asola Cathedral (1524) depict Saints Andrew and Erasmus externally and Augustus with the Tiburtine Sibyl plus the Sacrifice of Isaac on the interior side.
quote: Le ante d'organo di Girolamo Romanino del 1524 ... lato esterno raffigura i santi Andrea ed Erasmo ... lato interno Augusto e la Sibilla Tiburtina e il Sacrificio di Isacco

claim: Asola's fortifications include a Visconti-era Fossa Magna moat and, after demolition of the Rocca Grande in 1458, an irregular quadrilateral wall with fourteen cylindrical towers and the Rocchetta.
quote: fortezza dalla forma di un quadrilatero irregolare con cortina muraria interrotta da quattordici torri cilindriche

claim: The Fondazione Don Primo Mazzolari in Bozzolo is open to the public Monday-Friday 10:30-11:30, preserving the archive and writings of the prophetic Catholic priest who influenced Vatican II.
quote: La Fondazione don Primo Mazzolari e aperta al pubblico dal lunedi al venerdi dalle 10:30 alle 11:30

claim: The Fondazione Don Primo Mazzolari was established in 1981 at Via Castello 15, Bozzolo, to collect and disseminate the documentary heritage of the priest.
quote: Fondazione don Primo Mazzolari ... costituita nel 1981 ... sede in via Castello 15 a Bozzolo

claim: The Museo Diotti in Casalmaggiore, opened 2007 in the painter's former palace, presents Giuseppe Diotti's home-atelier across eight rooms of the piano nobile covering his neoclassical Roman training and Bergamo Carrara Academy directorship.
quote: casa-atelier di Giuseppe Diotti si distribuisce in otto stanze del piano nobile ... ogni aspetto dell'attivita del pittore, dagli anni di studio a Roma alle opere della maturita

claim: The Museo del Bijou in Casalmaggiore preserves over 20,000 pieces of costume jewellery produced by local gold-plating industries from the late 19th century to 1970, open Tuesday-Saturday 10-12 and 15-18.
quote: more than 20 thousand pieces of ornaments and accessories ... Tuesday to Saturday: 10:00-12:00 and 15:00-18:00; Sunday and holidays: 15:00-19:00

claim: The Ostiano synagogue, in the inner courtyard of the Gonzaga castle and used by the Jewish community from 1713 until the early 1900s, suffered a roof collapse in February 2006 and was acquired by the municipality in 2008 for restoration.
quote: La sinagoga di Ostiano ... in piazza Castello, nel cortile interno del palazzo Gonzaghesco ... il 3 febbraio 2006, a causa delle copiose nevicate, il tetto dell'edificio crollo

claim: Ostiano hosted one of the oldest Jewish communities in the Cremona-Mantua area, with a synagogue active inside the Gonzaga castle complex from the early 18th century.
quote: lands between the river Po and the river Oglio ... Jewish itinerary including Ostiano

claim: The Museo Archeologico Platina in Piadena documents human settlement from the Upper Paleolithic to the Early Middle Ages and holds a rich Roman section on the nearby town of Bedriacum on the Via Postumia, including the Domus del Labirinto mosaic of Theseus and the Minotaur.
quote: sezione dedicata a Bedriacum, piccolo centro romano del vicino territorio di Calvatone ... mosaico centrale raffigura il leggendario labirinto di Cnosso, al centro del quale e raffigurato il Minotauro ferito a morte

claim: The Church of San Tommaso in Acquanegra sul Chiese is the surviving 11th-century abbey church with a Latin-cross three-nave plan; recently revealed floor mosaics depict symbolic animals and the nave walls hold Old Testament frescoes of notable quality.
quote: antica chiesa abbaziale di Acquanegra, a pianta a croce latina e a tre navate ... sotto il pavimento sono stati rinvenuti mosaici di pregevole fattura raffiguranti animali simbolici

claim: San Martino dall'Argine's parish church Santa Maria Annunciata (the 'Chiesa del Castello') was built in 1581-82 at the impulse of Cardinal Scipione Gonzaga and the village holds vast historical possessions of the Benedictine Abbey of Leno.
quote: La chiesa parrocchiale di Santa Maria Annunciata (Chiesa del Castello) fu edificata negli anni 1581-82 per impulso del cardinale Scipione Gonzaga

claim: Volongo, on the left bank of the Oglio in Cremona province, contains the late-Romanesque bell tower of its parish church of Saints Peter and Paul and, just outside town, the nearly millennial Chiesa della Beata Vergine del Buonconsiglio ('Torricella').
quote: campanile tardo-romanico ... Chiesa della Beata Vergine del Buonconsiglio, detta Torricella, probabilmente la piu antica costruzione sacra del cremonese, quasi millenaria

claim: Casalmaggiore lies on the VenTo Po cycle route and offers riverside access at the Lido Po, used as an embarkation point for river-tourism trips.
quote: Lido Po Casalmaggiore ... punto di imbarco per attivita di turismo fluviale

claim: Parco Oglio Sud has two visitor centres relevant to Canneto: one at Acquanegra sul Chiese near Le Bine and one at Canneto sull'Oglio (Ecomuseo Valli Oglio Chiese, Piazza Gramsci).
quote: I centri visita all'interno del Parco Oglio Sud sono ubicati ad Acquanegra sul Chiese, presso la Riserva Naturale Le Bine e a Canneto sull'Oglio.

claim: Parco Oglio Sud protects the lower Oglio valley from the Mella confluence to its confluence with the Po, across Cremona and Mantova provinces.
quote: The Parco Oglio Sud territory extends along the entire course of the Oglio river, from the confluence of the Mella river at the border with Parco Oglio Nord to the confluence with the Po river.

claim: The Ciclovia dell'Oglio runs about 280 km across Lombardy (Brescia, Bergamo, Cremona, Mantova provinces), roughly 80% asphalt and 20% unpaved, descending from Passo del Tonale to San Matteo delle Chiaviche.
quote: circa 280 km ... all'80% su asfalto e 20% su sterrato ... Passo del Tonale (1.883 m) ... Ponte di Barche a San Matteo delle Chiaviche (21 m)

claim: Riserva Naturale Le Bine sits at Strada Bine 1424, Acquanegra sul Chiese (MN), is open year-round with free admission on foot or by bike, and offers guided visits by reservation (+39 348 385 0901).
quote: Strada Bine, 1424 Acquanegra sul Chiese (MN) 46011 ... Le visite guidate sono disponibili per gruppi

claim: Le Bine is a WWF oasis built around an abandoned Oglio meander; its grey heron colony grew from one pair in 1955 to about 100, with breeding observable February–June, and peregrine falcon visits in winter.
quote: dalla prima coppia del 1955 alle circa 100 attuali ... da febbraio a giugno ... falco pellegrino

claim: Le Bine covers 96.45 hectares, was established by the Lombardy region on 1 October 1987, and hosts grey heron, bittern, cormorant, mallard, garganey and marsh harrier.
quote: 96,45 ettari ... istituita dalla regione Lombardia con Decreto di Consiglio nº 769 del 1º ottobre 1987 ... airone cenerino ... tarabuso ... falco di palude

claim: As of April 2026, the Ciclovia VENTO segment through Casalmaggiore is physically complete and ridable, though still awaiting official inauguration by AIPO.
quote: Non è ancora stata inaugurata ufficialmente, ma c'è già chi la percorre in bicicletta. A Casalmaggiore, la ciclovia VENTO è ormai realtà: oggi non solo è visibile, ma anche pienamente fruibile.

claim: The VENTO cycle path links Venice to Turin along the Po, totals about 700 km and is the Italian backbone of EuroVelo 8 (Mediterranean Route).
quote: VenTo ... ciclovia da 700 km che collega Torino a Venezia lungo il Po

claim: The 115 km VENTO section completed in 2025 runs from Stagno Lombardo through Cremona, Casalmaggiore and Viadana, the latter just ~20 km south of Canneto sull'Oglio.
quote: 115 km ... da San Rocco al Porto ... raggiunge Cremona, Casalmaggiore e Viadana

claim: The Mantova–Peschiera Mincio cycle path runs 43.5 km with very modest elevation gain, taking around 4 hours, with shuttle service back from Mantova.
quote: 43.5 km long ... very modest elevation gain ... return shuttle service

claim: The Mantova–Peschiera ciclabile is part of the EuroVelo 7 network and is one of Italy's most-used cycle paths, drawing over 200,000 cyclists a year.
quote: part of the EuroVelo 7 cycling network ... over 200,000 cyclists every year

claim: EuroVelo 8 (Mediterranean Route) follows the Po in Italy; Mantova province carries it for about 190 km — left bank Viadana–Ostiglia, right bank Suzzara–Felonica.
quote: Il territorio mantovano è interessato per circa 190 km lungo il fiume Po: in sinistra idraulica da Viadana a Ostiglia, in destra idraulica da Suzzara a Felonica.

claim: Mantovabikexperience rents bikes (including e-bikes) at the Bicigrill in Valletta Valsecchi (Via Ariosto 22, Mantova) and offers shuttles for the Mantova–Peschiera route.
quote: Bike rental | Mantua-Peschiera cycle path | Mantovabikexperience

claim: The Riserva Naturale Torbiere di Marcaria, a small Oglio-oxbow wetland in Parco Oglio Sud, hosts a heron colony plus little egret, little bittern, garganey, marsh harrier, kingfisher and black kite, with one bird hide and an observation tower.
quote: little egret, little grebe, little bittern, garganey, marsh harrier, kingfisher, black kite ... one bird hide ... observation tower

claim: Lido Po at Casalmaggiore is a river-beach recreation area in the Parco Golena del Po with sports courts and seasonal beach venues, though periodic Po floods can close it.
quote: Lido Po ... Parco Golena del Po ... regina delle spiagge fluviali

claim: Cantina Sociale di Quistello (Via Roma 46, 46026 Quistello MN), founded 1928, is the only Lambrusco Mantovano producer to have won 2 Bicchieri and the Oscar Qualità/Prezzo in the Gambero Rosso guide; weekday hours 08:00-12:00 / 14:30-18:00, Saturday 08:00-12:00.
quote: Unico Lambrusco Mantovano premiato con: 2 Bicchieri ... Oscar Qualità/prezzo Gambero Rosso ... Via Roma 46, 46026 Quistello (MN)

claim: Lambrusco Mantovano DOC is split into two sub-zones — 'Viadanese-Sabbionetano' (between the Oglio and Po) and 'Oltre Po Mantovano' (right of the Po) — with grapes Lambrusco Viadanese, Maestri, Marani and Salamino (min 85%).
quote: Lambrusco Mantovano ... sottozone 'Viadanese-Sabbionetano' e 'Oltre Po Mantovano' ... Lambrusco Viadanese, Lambrusco Maestri, Lambrusco Marani e Lambrusco Salamino

claim: Latteria San Pietro in Goito (Via Segrada 36, 46044 Goito MN) offers a guided tour and three tasting menus including 'Mantua' (Grana Padano + salame mantovano + mostarda + wine), 'La Classica' (two ageings + wine) and 'The Fantastic 4' (four cheese categories).
quote: Three menu choices ... The Fantastic 4 ... La Classica ... Mantua: Grana Padano PDO, Mantuan salami, mustard, and wine ... Via Segrada, 36, 46044 Goito (MN)

claim: Caseificio AR.CRE.MAN. at Quattrocase di Casalmaggiore (Cremona province, ~18 km from Canneto) sits in the alluvial plain between the Po and Oglio and produces ~40 Grana Padano wheels per day — a viable in-radius dairy-tour candidate.
quote: Agricoltori Riuniti Cremonesi Mantovani ... Quattrocase di Casalmaggiore ... produce 40 forme di Grana Padano al giorno

claim: Le Tamerici (Via Romana Zuccona 208, San Biagio di Bagnolo San Vito MN) makes 15+ varieties of Mostarda Mantovana plus jams and wine jellies; the renovated Corte Forcello includes a shop and a 300 m² space for tastings and cookery courses — though the farm is on the east side of Mantova, beyond a 30 km radius from Canneto.
quote: Via Romana Zuccona 208 – 46031 S. Biagio di Bagnolo S. Vito (MN) ... Mostarda Mantovana (15+ varieties ...) ... shop and a 300 m² event space ... organize tastings, cookery courses

claim: Negozio Sperlari at Via Solferino 25 in Cremona (~28 km from Canneto) is the historic 1836 shop with 18th-century frescoes uncovered in a 2011 restoration, holds the oldest commercial licence in the province and was royal supplier to Queen Margherita (1921) and Prince Umberto (1929).
quote: stabilito nel 1836 ... via Solferino, 25 ... la più antica licenza commerciale della provincia ... fornitore della Real Casa ... Regina Margherita ... Principe Umberto

claim: Palazzo Vergani in Cremona offers a guided experience pairing torrone and mostarda history at the former Vergani factory residence, open to visitors on selected dates by booking.
quote: IL TORRONE E LA MOSTARDA A PALAZZO VERGANI DI CREMONA: DALL'ANTICA FABBRICA ALLA TAVOLA DELLE FESTE

claim: Festa del Torrone Cremona 2026 runs 7–22 November (16 days across three weekends, expanded from the previous 9-day format), with Sperlari, Vergani, Rivoltini and Pernigotti among the sponsors and Sperlari marking its 190th anniversary.
quote: Festa del Torrone 2026: dal 7 al 22 novembre sedici giorni di eventi ... Sperlari Spa, Rivoltini Alimentare Dolciaria srl, Vergani spa, Pernigotti spa ... Sperlari ... 190° anniversario

claim: Cesarine offers a 3-hour hands-on tortelli di zucca + tagliatelle al ragù di pesto mantovano + tiramisù cooking class in Mantova at €133 per guest (€67 children), max 4 guests, hosted by Cesarina Lina since 2023.
quote: Tortelli di Zucca ... 3h ... Max 4 ospiti ... €133 per guest (€67 for children) ... tortelli di zucca, tagliatelle with Mantuan pesto ragù, and tiramisu

claim: Salumificio Predaroli & Bonandi (Via Toscana 22, Asola MN — ~11 km from Canneto) was founded in 1950 to valorise the Mantuan butcher tradition; their salame mantovano is hand-worked, seasoned with fresh garlic, Sicilian sea salt and Lambrusco Mantovano IGP, and sold directly to consumers on-site.
quote: Salumificio Predaroli & Bonandi ... fondato ad Asola, in provincia di Mantova, nel 1950 ... via Toscana, 22 ... aromi naturali quali aglio fresco, pepe in grani, sale marino di Sicilia e Lambrusco Mantovano IGP

claim: Salame Mantovano is currently a PAT (Traditional Agri-food Product) recognised among Northern Italy's best traditional salami but has not yet obtained IGP certification — the Consorzio Salame Mantovano (Via Cappello 5, Mantova) is pursuing the application.
quote: Salame Mantovano ... fra i più noti del Nord Italia ... Prodotti Agroalimentari Tradizionali (PAT) ... Consorzio Salame Mantovano ... domanda di registrazione

claim: The Parmigiano Reggiano zone in Mantua province lies strictly to the right (south) of the Po river, so Canneto sull'Oglio and most of the Cremona/Mantova plain north of the Po — including Casalmaggiore — fall outside PR territory and inside Grana Padano DOP territory.
quote: In Mantua province, the production of milk and transformation into Parmigiano Reggiano cheese is made to the right of the River Po

claim: Dal Pescatore is a restaurant only (28 seats, reservation-required) at località Runate 15, Canneto sull'Oglio, with no on-site lodging mentioned.
quote: località Runate 15, Runate, 46013, Italia

claim: Canneto sull'Oglio has its own Trenord station on the Brescia-Parma railway with roughly hourly service; the town sits ~35 km west of Mantua and ~100 km southeast of Milan.
quote: Canneto sull'Oglio station, located along the Brescia-Parma railroad, is served by regional trains operated by Trenord

claim: Trenord operates the R40 Cremona-Mantova regional and the RE11 Mantova-Cremona-Codogno-Milano RegioExpress, the two main lines threading the area around Canneto.
quote: Cremona-Mantova Regional Line | Trenord

claim: Closest accommodation to Dal Pescatore: La Casa Nel Borgo (Castelfranco d'Oglio, 2 km), 9 Muse B&B (Canneto, 3 km), Claire Rooms & Apartments (Piadena Drizzona, 5 km), Borgo Dei Duchi (Rivarolo Mantovano, 13 km).
quote: La Casa Nel Borgo - Castelfranco d'Oglio, Piadena Drizzona (CR) - Distance: 2 km ... 9 Muse - Canneto sull'Oglio (MN) - Distance: 3 km

claim: Palazzo Ducale in Mantua is closed on Mondays plus 25 December and 1 January — the standard Italian state-museum Monday closure applies.
quote: The Ducal Palace of Mantua is closed on Mondays, December 25th and January 1st

claim: Cremona's Museo del Violino is closed Mondays and runs Tue-Fri 11:00-17:00, Sat-Sun 10:00-18:00, with a €14 entry as of January 2026.
quote: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday from 11am to 5pm, Saturday and Sunday from 10am to 6pm

claim: Sabbioneta's Teatro all'Antica is open Tuesday-Sunday and closed Mondays — meaning a Monday day-trip to Sabbioneta would find the main monument shut.
quote: da Mar. a Dom. 9.00-18.00

claim: Festivaletteratura 2026 — the 30th edition — runs 9-13 September 2026 in Mantua; the 2025 edition drew ~69,000 attendees, so accommodation that week tightens sharply.
quote: Appuntamento dal 9 al 13 settembre 2026

claim: Best time to visit Mantua is mid-April to mid-June plus September; summers can reach 36-37°C heatwaves with muggy 'oppressive' air, and historic Po-valley winter fog has become rarer in recent decades.
quote: The best times to visit Mantua are spring and early summer, particularly from mid-April to mid-June. September is also a good month

claim: The Po Valley has a humid subtropical climate with year-round high relative humidity and frequent November-March fog (nebbia), particularly in its central zone around Mantua.
quote: Between November and March, the Po Valley is often covered by fog

claim: The Pianura Padana is one of Italy's worst regions for summer mosquitoes (zanzare), driven by the same humidity/heat combination that gives the area its notorious 'afa'.
quote: The Pianura Padana plain in the Emilia-Romagna region is among the areas where you can find more mosquitoes than in other areas

claim: Weekly markets in the area: Canneto sull'Oglio on Wednesday morning in Piazza Gramsci; Asola on Saturday morning; Casalmaggiore on Saturday morning in Piazza Garibaldi; Mantua's main mercato is also Thursday-morning territory.
quote: Canneto sull'Oglio ... mercoledì ... Piazza Gramsci ... 08:00 alle 12:30

claim: Palazzo Quaranta in Isola Dovarese is a commonly recommended palazzo-style hotel for Dal Pescatore diners, in the village ~15 km away on the Cremona side.
quote: Lovely Palazzo hotel close to Dal Pescatore restaurant
